engine_name: Autonomous Production Scheduler, Queue & Dependency Execution Engine
purpose: Convert CMSE-014 route decisions into an idempotent, dependency-aware, resumable production execution plan and queue.
core_principle: Scheduling controls when and how an approved job executes; it never changes what the job means.
dependency_rules: A job cannot dispatch until all hard dependencies are SUCCEEDED.
Soft dependencies may be satisfied by approved fallback/reference state.
Dependency cycles are a hard failure.
A failed dependency blocks descendants unless an explicit recovery policy exists.
F01 canonical/reference assets may be dependencies for later frames when explicitly declared.
Frame independence must never be assumed when continuity/reference lineage declares a dependency.
scheduling_rules: Respect queue depth and rate limits when supplied.
Do not dispatch the same idempotency key twice.
Preserve route decision; re-routing requires CMSE-014.
Use bounded exponential backoff with jitter policy.
A retry cannot mutate the production payload.
Execution can resume from persisted job state.

pass_conditions: eight route jobs converted to execution jobs
